## 4.3.1 (HexGhoul): NPCs follow you only when you ask; official NPCs stop killing you over stray hits

HexKagune 4.3.1 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. Protocol unchanged (132): a 4.3.0 server and players can update in any order.

You said (quoted exactly): "whenever you're talking to them and you reach a friendly state with them, they start following you out of
nowhere. Like, I don't understand. Like, without you telling them to follow, they just follow you for no given reason." And: "I'm doing the
quest with Ito, that you gotta kill a few CCG agents in front of her. Like, for some reason, I'm attacking the CCG agents. She gets pissed at
me and spam kills me. She kills me over and over and over again for no reason. ... official NPCs should not attack you, unless you fucking get
rid of 50 heart, 50 HP or something ... they can get pissed at you, sure. You not talk to you if they get pissed at you, but starting to kill
you while you're while you told them to follow you and all is ridiculous."

**Why they followed you:** once you are friendly, Eto, Touka and Ken come up to you by themselves with little scenes ("Walk with me. I need
to stretch my legs", "Would you come with me?", "Let me walk you home"). The warm answers ("Let's go.", "Go with him.", "Walk with me.",
"Show me your stars.") quietly told them to follow you, and nothing ever told them to stop. 55 answers did it, in their scenes and in the
ally ghouls'. A date did the same: she followed you to the date's place and kept following you for good after it.

**Now:** only **"Follow me."** makes anyone follow you. No scene answer does any more (the words are the same, the following is gone). A date
still has her follow you to its place, but only for the date: once it is had, missed, or you log out (or the server restarts), she stops
where she is, as if you had said "Wait here.", and goes home in her own time.

**Why they killed you over and over:** every hit you landed on an official NPC, even a stray one, cost 30 of her regard and started a fight
at once. In Eto's "Let me watch you" she follows you and joins the fight against the Doves, so your kagune catches her again and again. Two
hits took a friend to "enemy", and an enemy was attacked on sight, forever. Because she was following you, she was always next to you when
you respawned, so it never ended.

**Now (the officials: Eto, Touka, Ken, Ayato, Noro, the General, Roma, Banjou):**
- **One who follows you can't be hit by you**, the same as your ally ghouls already were: your kagune, fists and shots pass her by, so you
  can fight the Doves right beside Eto.
- **A hit while you are fighting something else is an accident:** no regard lost, nothing held against you.
- **A hit on purpose stings** (a little regard, at most once a second, and she tells you to watch it), but **she only fights back once you
  have done her 50 health on purpose** (your "50 HP"). Then she stops following you.
- **Your death ends it:** no official keeps a grudge past it, so you never respawn into her again.
- **Angry is not a fight:** a bad regard ("enemy") or an insult means she won't talk to you (and stops following you), never that she
  attacks you. Eto's, Touka's, Ayato's and the General's insult answers no longer threaten a fight that never comes.

Your partner (dating or married) still never fights you back, as before. Ayato's spar still fights for real. Wild ghouls, gangs, the CCG and
Arima are unchanged.

**Still to come:** tell me how it plays, and whether any other NPC still follows you or turns on you without a reason.
